narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Fourteen take away eight is six, and twenty one take away eight is thirteen, so six to thirteen.
<bookmark mark='why'/>Taking away the same amount does not keep eigh ratio.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Mixing like that would change the colour of the kolam, so that slip is wrong.
